title: Garnet Back Country Byway
summary: The 12-mile long Garnet Back Country Byway climbs 2,000 feet through the scenic Garnet Range to Garnet Ghost Town. Thanks to extensive preservation efforts, the 30 buildings in this historic town look much the same as they did in 1895. Depending on weather, the visitor center is open daily from late May through September, from 10 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
